items.headline: From Hugging Face to GitHub: Tracing License Drift in the Open-Source AI Ecosystem
items.summary:
arXiv:2509.09873v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Hidden license conflicts in the open-source AI ecosystem pose serious legal and ethical risks, exposing organizations to potential litigation and users to undisclosed risk. However, the field lacks a data-driven understanding of how frequently these conflicts occur, where they originate, and which communities are most affected.
